SUBSCRIPTION CONTRACT – FICTIONAL SAMPLE

You signed up for a trial subscription (clicked "try for free").
The subscription auto-renews for 24 months.

Monthly fee: 89.00 EUR
Total cost: 2,136.00 EUR

Cancellation only by registered letter to an address in Cyprus.
Cancellation deadline: 90 days before renewal.
No right of withdrawal after activation.
Non-payment triggers automatic charge via "partner companies."

Provider: StreamMaxPlus (imprint incomplete)
